decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program launched only in 2023, has its own page, and builds on established psychiatric expertise, so its value is still uncertain and the option is worth keeping.
The carpentry workshop draws on existing sheltered-workshop production know-how, so it costs little to carry, and with only one year on the market its uncertainty has not yet resolved against it.
Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core offer and has low carrying cost, but its minimal website presence suggests some risk, so management keeps the option open for now.
Senior living counseling is featured on the home page, is cheap to run, and supports the core eldercare business, so there is no evidence it should be dropped.
The retail shop is only mentioned on the website and uncertainty about it remains, but it is a low-cost outlet for workshop goods and is worth keeping while its results unfold.
